subject: DIF Effect size estimates for multidimensional models?

messages.author: d5c7223b5e875974
messages.subject: DIF Effect size estimates for multidimensional models?
parts:
Hi Dr. Chalmers, 

This may very well be an ignorant question, so I apologize in advance if it is.
I was wondering though if it is possible to get effect size estimates with a multidimensional graded response model like you can do for unidimensional models using 'Empirical_ES()?'
I am basically testing for DIF between males and females and was originally doing so in the unidimensional context, but am afraid that this may be inappropriate given the scale I am using (the literature seems to be mixed though on this issue from the couple of papers that I have read). 

Thank you in advance for your time!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: DIF Effect size estimates for multidimensional models?
parts:
Something like this could certainly be done, though I haven't had the time or motivation to do so. In true I think it would be more meaningful to investigate extensions of the DRF statistics since these have more optimal bias/sampling precision properties anyway. That said, I'm open to pull requests for those interested in including extensions of many of these measures to multidimensional models.

Phil
